**■Healing Glyph■**
Each team has a healing glyph situated to the front of its starting point. While standing on the glyph, players will sustain 50% less damage and recover HP over time. Please note that these benefits are not granted by the opposing team's glyph.

Tool mastery missions are only available to those who have completed a cosmic tool.

Unlike normal stellar missions, the aim is to achieve the highest possible score within an allotted time.

These missions include multiple intermediate objectives whose completion bonuses include extension of the time limit, additional use of duty actions, and increased evaluation scores.

**Tool mastery points** are granted upon completion of a tool mastery mission, in accordance with the final score.
**Please refer to the Tool Mastery Points heading for more information.**

Bring to bear your experience and expertise as a Disciple of the Hand or Land, and reach for the stars!

■Accepting Missions
Tool mastery missions can be accepted via the Tool Mastery Missions tab of the Stellar Missions window.
**This section will only be displayed on Auxesia.**

Tool mastery points are gained in accordance with scores from tool mastery missions and accumulate for each individual class.

Total points will be displayed for each class, demonstrating your mastery with each tool. Reaching certain milestones with a specific class will grant achievements and, in some cases, titles.

Current points can be checked via the mission selection list, or via an overview found in the tool mastery point section of the Cosmic Class Tracker, accessed from your exotablet.

**Earn the achievements for all classes to obtain a special reward!**

Reaching an objective will result in the following kinds of changes: 
・Time limit: 2:00 → 3:20
・GP: 350/900 → 850/900 **
※GP will not be restored beyond maximum. **
・Duty action: 2/2 → 3/3
・Score multiplier: 100% → 150%

■Tips
The key to success is to **use duty actions to reach objectives** and achieve a higher score.

When an objective is met, the score multiplier will increase, and each subsequent point will contribute more to the overall score.

Once you can comfortably complete certain missions with a limited number of duty actions, it may be wise to save those actions to use ** once your score multiplier has increased**. This will allow you to increase your score more effectively.

However, should you focus too much on keeping duty actions in reserve, you may fail to meet the objectives within the time limit.
Striking the appropriate balance is essential! 

For Disciples of the Land, making effective use of your GP before reaching an objective will allow for more GP to be recovered, giving you more opportunity to achieve a higher score. 

If you are struggling to complete tool mastery missions or boost your score, try using medicines and meals for Disciples of the Hand and Land or reviewing your gear and materia.

It is also important to consider **the actions you use and the order in which you use them**.

■Rewards 
Upon completion of a mission, you will receive tool mastery points in accordance with your score.

Cosmic class score and contribution to the Starward Standings will also increase accordingly, up to a maximum amount granted per mission.

Credits and exploration tokens are not impacted by score.

■Mission High Score
A high score will be recorded for each tool mastery mission completed. 

High scores can be viewed on the mission selection screen.

Retry missions and find ways to achieve a new high score on your path to earning the related achievements and titles! 

■Bonuses
Tool mastery missions marked with a symbol on the mission select screen will bestow a bonus, granting 1.2 times the standard amount of tool mastery points.

■Gold Count
Completing or abandoning tool mastery missions will not affect your gold count.

■Requirements 
Tool mastery missions are only available on Auxesia when the cosmic tool of the corresponding class has been completed.

■Mission Progression
There are **two different score objectives** in tool mastery missions.

**You may choose to complete the mission at any point after reaching the first objective.**

If, however, you wish to aim for a higher score, you can continue working towards the second.

After reaching both the first and second objective, the mission will continue until the time runs out. During this remaining time, you can further increase your score.

■Completion Bonuses 
A bonus will be granted upon reaching the first and second objectives, with the following effects:
・Increased time limit
・Additional uses of the mission duty action
・GP recovery

An extra 50% or 100% boost will also be added to the score multiplier, making it easier to achieve an even higher score.
